app.title: SCR Tools
settings.prevent_sleep: Prevent system sleep while Mouse Mover is enabled
settings.movement_hint: External input cancels movement immediately. The pointer returns to its starting pixel only after an uninterrupted cycle.
settings.hotkey_hint: Example: Ctrl+Shift+F11. Use Ctrl, Alt, Shift, or Win with a letter, digit, or function key. F12 is reserved by Windows.
settings.screenshot_hint: One explicit capture request saves lossless PNG files at native resolution. No selection, filename, or save dialog appears during capture.
settings.minimized: Start minimized to the system tray
settings.startup_supported: Applies to the current packaged executable, for this Windows user only.
settings.startup_source: Automatic startup is available in the packaged executable. Source execution never registers a Python startup command.
settings.tray_hint: Close, Alt+F4, and minimize hide this window. Use Exit SCR Tools in the tray menu to quit. Windows may put the icon in its overflow panel.
settings.privacy_hint: No telemetry or uploads. Input monitoring retains event times only. Screenshots are taken only when you request them.
settings.ready: Changes to these settings take effect after Apply settings.
settings.language_restart: Settings saved. Exit from the tray and restart SCR Tools to apply the selected language.
settings.invalid_number: Enter whole numbers for timeout and path size, and a valid number for duration.
settings.wait_hotkey: Wait for the current shortcut registration to finish, then apply again.
settings.save_failed: Settings could not be applied or saved. Check application-data permissions and Windows startup access.
settings.session_only: The Mouse Mover state changed for this session, but the preference could not be saved.
settings.startup_rollback_failed: Settings failed to save and the previous Windows startup registration could not be restored. Check your Windows startup settings.
settings.hotkey_save_failed: The previous shortcut is still active, but its restored preference could not be saved.
settings.startup_read_failed: The Windows startup preference could not be read or synchronized. Check access to your user settings.
status.initializing: Initializing input monitoring and the system tray...
status.user_priority: Move the pointer or press a key to cancel.
status.capture_available: Automatic movement and power requests are paused. Screenshots remain available.
status.stopping: Exiting SCR Tools. Releasing native resources and finishing any active image write...
movement.busy: A movement request is already in progress.
movement.unavailable: Movement is unavailable until the session, normal desktop, and input monitoring are ready.
movement.test_wait: Test starting shortly. Keep the pointer and keyboard still.
capture.ready: No screenshots taken in this session.
capture.open_failed: The screenshot folder could not be created or opened. Check its path and permissions.
native.host_failed: The Windows desktop service could not start or stopped unexpectedly. SCR Tools will close after cleaning up. Check the diagnostic log and restart.
native.hooks_failed: Global input monitoring is unavailable. Automatic movement and power requests are paused; restart SCR Tools to retry.
native.hotkey_conflict: Could not register {requested}. Any previous shortcut is kept. Capture now remains available.
native.session_available: The interactive desktop is available. A fresh idle interval has started.
native.session_unavailable: Waiting for the unlocked, connected session and normal input desktop.
native.power_failed: Windows could not apply the requested sleep-prevention state. Check the diagnostic log.
native.tray_ready: The SCR Tools tray icon is available.
native.tray_unavailable: The tray icon is temporarily unavailable. This window stays accessible while SCR Tools retries registration.
native.callback_failed: A Windows event could not be processed. Check the diagnostic log.
native.capture_unavailable: Capture is unavailable on the locked, disconnected, or secure desktop.
error.runtime: SCR Tools requires Windows 11 x64 and system CPython 3.14 x64. Run with py -3.14 run_scr_tools.py, or use the packaged Windows executable.
error.instance_activation: SCR Tools is already running, but its window could not be activated. Check the system tray and try again after startup finishes.
error.logging: Diagnostic logging is unavailable because the per-user log folder could not be opened.
error.callback: An interface error paused automation. Use the tray menu to exit, then restart SCR Tools.
error.startup: SCR Tools could not start. Verify the Python version, installed dependencies, and access to Windows Pictures and application-data folders. Check the diagnostic log when available.
